The '''Akwin speeder''' was a variant of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] utilized by the [[Akwin]], an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. It was capable of traveling underwater and had variant models that were also capable of traveling either through [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] or on land.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Akwin speeder was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The guidebook instructs gamemasters to treat the Akwin speeder as the underwater equivalent to [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]].<ref name="TSoK" />
